## Setup

```{r}

               SeuratDisk,

               ggplot2,
               glmGamPoi,

               RColorBrewer,
               ktplots,
               viridis)


# set working directory and chunk opts
basedir <- "~/Projects/Johnsen_group/scRNA_seq/pancreas_hsap/GEO_datasets_raw/hg38_aligned"
setwd(basedir)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(root.dir = basedir, fig.width = 13, warning = F, include = F)


# read in multiplet rate reference (from 10x)
mrates <- data.table::fread("~/Reference/multiplets_vs_cells_10x_ref.tsv")

# define a function to auto-filter nFeatures/nCounts/percent.mt based on MADs
is_outlier <- function(seurat_obj, metric, nmads = 3) {
  M <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[metric]]
  med <- median(M, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad_val <- mad(M, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  outlier <- (M < med - nmads * mad_val) | (M > med + nmads * mad_val)
  return(outlier)
}

# define function to automatically take PC cutoffs, add 1
pc_cutoff <- function(sobj) {
  # Determine percent of variation associated with each PC
  pct <- sobj[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(sobj[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100
  # Calculate cumulative percents for each PC
  cumu <- cumsum(pct)
  # Determine which PC exhibits cumulative percent greater than 90% and
  ## % variation associated with the PC as less than 5
  co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]
  # Determine the difference between variation of PC and subsequent PC
  # last point where change of % of variation is more than 0.1%.
  co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1
  # Minimum of the two calculation
  pcs <- min(co1, co2)
  return(pcs + 1)
}


## Define a function to filter seurat obj and remove doublets
filt_sobj <- function(sobj, assay_name = DefaultAssay(sobj),
                      nmads=5, nmads_mt=3, perc_mt=25) {

  require(DoubletFinder)

  sobj$nFeature_RNA_outlier <- is_outlier(sobj, "nFeature_RNA", 5)
  cat(sprintf("Number of nFeature_RNA outliers @ %d mads: %d",
              nmads, sum(sobj$nFeature_RNA_outlier)))
  sobj$nCount_RNA_outlier <- is_outlier(sobj, "nCount_RNA", 5)
  cat(sprintf("\nNumber of nCount_RNA outliers @ %d mads: %d",
          nmads, sum(sobj$nCount_RNA_outlier)))
  # sobj$percent_MT_outlier <- is_outlier_mt(sobj, "percent_MT", 3)
  # cat(sprintf("\nNumber of percent_MT outliers @ %d mads: %d)",
  #             nmads_mt, sum(sobj$percent_MT_outlier)))

  cat(sprintf("\nCells pre-filter: %d\n", ncol(sobj)))
  # if (!is.na(sum(sobj$percent_MT_outlier))) {
  #   sobj <- subset(sobj, subset = percent_MT_outlier == F)
  # }
  sobj <- subset(sobj, subset = percent_MT < 25)
  sobj <- subset(sobj, subset = nFeature_RNA_outlier == F | nCount_RNA_outlier == F)
  cat(sprintf("\nCells post-filter: %d\n", ncol(sobj)))

  sobj <- sobj %>% NormalizeData() %>% FindVariableFeatures() %>% ScaleData() 

  if (ncol(sobj) <= 50) {
    sobj <- RunPCA(sobj, npcs = 30)
  } else {sobj <- RunPCA(sobj)}

  pcs <- pc_cutoff(sobj)

  # Parameter sweep for optimal pK
  sweep.res.list <- paramSweep(sobj, PCs = 1:pcs, sct = F)
  sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
  bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

  # Selecting optimal pK based on the maximum BCmetric
  optimal.pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

  # get doublet estimation based on refs
  mrates_lm <- lm(multiplet_rate ~ cells_recovered, data = mrates)
  mrate_pred <- predict(mrates_lm, data.frame(cells_recovered = ncol(sobj))) %>%
    round(digits = 2) / 100

  # Estimate the expected number of doublets
  nExp_poi <- round(mrate_pred * nrow(sobj@meta.data))

  # Run DoubletFinder
  sobj <- doubletFinder(sobj, PCs = 1:pcs, pN = 0.25, sct = F,
                        pK = optimal.pK, nExp = nExp_poi, reuse.pANN = NULL)
  # Assigning column names in a vector
  column_names <- colnames(sobj@meta.data)

  # Set idents as the doublet status within the seurat_sample
  ident_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(sobj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  Idents(sobj) <- column_names[which(column_names == ident_col)]

  # Subset the seurat_sample to contain only singlets
  sobj <- subset(sobj, idents = 'Singlet')
  return(sobj)
  gc()
}


## function to remove ambient RNA contamination
run_decontX <- function(seu_obj) {
  cat("Inital cell count:", ncol(seu_obj), "\n")
  counts <- LayerData(seu_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts))
  sce <- decontX(sce)
  
  # Add decontXcounts assay (rounded integers)
  decont_counts <- round(decontXcounts(sce))
  seu_obj[["RNA_raw"]] <- seu_obj[["RNA"]]
  seu_obj[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = decont_counts)
  
  # Add contamination metadata
  seu_obj$decontX_contamination <- colData(sce)$decontX_contamination
  
  # Filter high contamination (>0.3; tune based on VlnPlot)
  seu_obj <- subset(seu_obj, subset = decontX_contamination < 0.3)
  
  cat("Cells kept:", ncol(seu_obj), "\n")
  return(seu_obj)
}

options(future.globals.maxSize = 2e11)
```


## Dataset filtering and processing
### GSE111672
```{r}

# list the raw files
dir_gse111672 <- file.path(basedir, "GSE111672/RAW")
filenames <- list.files(dir_gse111672,
                         pattern = "PDAC-A|PDAC-B|PDAC-C", full.names = T)
gse111672_list <- vector("list", length = length(filenames))
names(gse111672_list) <- filenames

# read the files into a list
for (i in names(gse111672_list)) {
  gse111672_list[[i]] <- read.delim(i, sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
}
names(gse111672_list) <- tstrsplit(basename(names(gse111672_list)), "\\.", keep = 1) %>% 
  unlist() 

# Create Seurat objects in list, rename cells, and run decontX
for (j in names(gse111672_list)) {
  gse111672_list[[j]] <- CreateSeuratObject(gse111672_list[[j]],
                                       project = names(gse111672_list[j]),
                                       min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  gse111672_list[[j]]$orig.ident <- unlist(tstrsplit(j, "_", keep = 1))
  gse111672_list[[j]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(gse111672_list[[j]], 
                                              pattern = "^MT-",
                                              col.name = "percent_MT")
  gse111672_list[[j]] <- RenameCells(gse111672_list[[j]], add.cell.id = j)
  gse111672_list[[j]] <- run_decontX(gse111672_list[[j]])
}

# check pre-filter metrics
VlnPlot(merge(x=gse111672_list[[1]], y=gse111672_list[-1]), 
        features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_MT"),
        group.by = "orig.ident")

# filtering
gse111672_list_filt <- lapply(gse111672_list, filt_sobj)

# merge and check post-filter metrics
gse111672_merge <- merge(gse111672_list_filt[[1]], gse111672_list_filt[-1])
VlnPlot(gse111672_merge, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_MT"),
        group.by = "orig.ident")


# edit metadata
gse111672_merge@meta.data <- gse111672_merge@meta.data[, !grepl("^(DF\\.classifications|pANN)", 
                                                                colnames(gse111672_merge@meta.data))]

gse111672_merge$Project <- "GSE111672"
sample_id <- unlist(tstrsplit(rownames(gse111672_merge@meta.data), "_cell", keep=1))
gse111672_merge$sample_id <- paste(gse111672_merge$Project, sample_id, sep = "_")
gse111672_merge$Type <- "Tumor"
gse111672_merge$Method <- "NextSeq_500"

saveRDS(gse111672_merge, file.path(basedir, "mad_filt_stdNorm_decontX_Apr26/gse111672_apr26.RDS")) 
rm(dir_gse111672, gse111672_list, gse111672_list_filt)
gc()

################################################################################\

seu <- gse111672_merge %>% NormalizeData() %>% FindVariableFeatures() %>% 
  ScaleData() %>% RunPCA()

res <- seq(0.1, 1, 0.1)
pcs <- pc_cutoff(seu)

seu <- seu %>% FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = res, algorithm = 4)

clustree(seu)

Idents(seu) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.4" 

seu <- RunUMAP(seu, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs, 
               reduction.name = "unintegrated")

DimPlot(seu, reduction = "unintegrated", 
        group.by = c("RNA_snn_res.0.4", "sample_id"))

rm(gse111672_merge, seu)
gc()
```

# note: omitted GSM7755916 = adenosquamous carcinoma
dir_gse242230 <- file.path(basedir, "GSE242230")
filename <- list.dirs(dir_gse242230, recursive = F)
filename <- filename[grep("GSM", filename)]

gse242230_list <- vector("list", length = length(filename))
names(gse242230_list) <- filename

# Read in 10x data into a list
for(i in filename){
  gse242230_list[[i]] <- Read10X(data.dir = i)
}
names(gse242230_list) <- basename(names(gse242230_list))

# Create Seurat objects in list
for(i in names(gse242230_list)){
  gse242230_list[[i]] <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = gse242230_list[[i]], 
                                       project = names(gse242230_list[i]), 
                                       min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  gse242230_list[[i]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(gse242230_list[[i]], 
                                              pattern = "^MT-",
                                              col.name = "percent_MT")
  gse242230_list[[i]] <- RenameCells(gse242230_list[[i]], add.cell.id = i)
  gse242230_list[[i]] <- run_decontX(gse242230_list[[i]])

### Meghna's scRNA

```{r}

meg_dir <- file.path(basedir, "scFFPE_Meghna")
filename <- list.files(meg_dir, pattern = "feature_bc_matrix", full.names = T)

meg_list <- vector("list", length = length(filename))
names(meg_list) <- filename

for (i in names(meg_list)) {
  meg_list[[i]] <- Read10X_h5(filename = i)
}
names(meg_list) <- basename(names(meg_list)) %>%
  tstrsplit("_", keep = 1) %>% unlist()

# Create Seurat objects in list
for(i in names(meg_list)){
  meg_list[[i]] <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = meg_list[[i]], 
                                 project = names(meg_list[i]), 
                                 min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  meg_list[[i]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(meg_list[[i]], pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent_MT")
  meg_list[[i]] <- RenameCells(meg_list[[i]], add.cell.id = i)
  meg_list[[i]] <- run_decontX(meg_list[[i]])
}

# check pre-filter metrics
VlnPlot(merge(x=meg_list[[1]], y=meg_list[-1]), 
        features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_MT"))

meg_list <- lapply(meg_list, filt_sobj)

meg_merged <- merge(meg_list[[1]], meg_list[-1])
VlnPlot(meg_merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_MT"),
        group.by = "orig.ident")


## edit meta data
meg_merged@meta.data <- meg_merged@meta.data[, !grepl("^(DF\\.classifications|pANN)", 
                                                      colnames(meg_merged@meta.data))]
meg_merged$Project <- "Meg"
meg_merged$Type <- "Tumor"
meg_merged$sample_id <- paste(meg_merged$Project, meg_merged$orig.ident, sep = "_")
meg_merged$Method <- "NextSeq_2000"

saveRDS(meg_merged, file = file.path(basedir, "mad_filt_stdNorm_decontX_Apr26/meg_apr26.RDS"))
rm(meg_dir, meg_list)
gc()

################################################################################

seu <- meg_merged %>% NormalizeData() %>% FindVariableFeatures() %>% 
  ScaleData() %>% RunPCA()

pcs <- pc_cutoff(seu)

res <- seq(0.1, 1, 0.1)
seu <- seu %>% FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = res, algorithm = 4)

clustree(seu)


Idents(seu) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.5" 

seu <- RunUMAP(seu, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs, 
               reduction.name = "unintegrated")

#DimPlot(seu, reduction = "unintegrated")
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "unintegrated", 
        group.by = c("RNA_snn_res.0.5", "sample_id"))

rm(meg_merged, seu)
gc()
```
